title: Phase 2: Verify database continuity
description:
1. Diff Prisma schemas: /backend/ToGODer/prisma/schema.prisma vs /togoder-monorepo/packages/core/prisma/schema.prisma — must be identical
2. Ensure prisma/migrations/ directory is complete in monorepo copy
3. Test prisma migrate deploy against backup copy of dev.db
4. Confirm new Docker setup will mount same host data path to /app/data
close_reason: Packages renamed, lock files removed, .env copied, schemas/migrations verified identical

title: Phase 1c: Add expo web export build to mobile-app
description: Add build script to packages/mobile-app that runs 'expo export --platform web'. Verify it outputs static files (index.html, assets, etc). This output will be served by Express in the unified container.
close_reason: build script added, expo export produces dist/ with index.html and 21 static routes

title: Phase 1d: Copy and configure .env for monorepo
description: Copy .env from /mnt/raid1/docker/togoder-dev/backend/ToGODer/.env to /mnt/raid1/docker/togoder-dev/togoder-monorepo/.env. Verify all env vars are present (PORT, DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, API keys, SMTP settings, etc). Update DATABASE_URL path if volume mount changes. Add .env to .gitignore if not already there.
close_reason: Packages renamed, lock files removed, .env copied, schemas/migrations verified identical

title: Phase 5: Cutover — stop old, start new, verify
description:
1. Stop old backend: cd /backend/ToGODer && docker compose down
2. Start monorepo backend: cd /togoder-monorepo && docker compose up -d --build
3. Reload nginx: docker exec nginx nginx -s reload
4. Verify: curl API, curl index.html, WebSocket, https://dev.togoder.click, login/chat/sync
5. Check logs: docker logs togoder-dev
close_reason: Old backend stopped, monorepo running on port 6968, nginx restarted. API, static files, SPA deep links all verified working.

title: Phase 1b: Install deps and verify turbo pipeline
description:
Run pnpm install at monorepo root. Add missing dev/build/lint scripts to each package.json so Turbo pipelines work. Verify pnpm build --filter=@togoder/core compiles TypeScript to bin/.

NOTE: packages/mcp-server and packages/book also exist in the workspace. Ensure their deps resolve cleanly during pnpm install, or temporarily exclude them from pnpm-workspace.yaml if they cause failures.
close_reason: pnpm install succeeds, turbo build compiles core to bin/

title: Phase 1a: Rename packages to scoped names
description:
Rename package.json names:
- packages/core: 'togoder' → '@togoder/core'
- packages/mobile-app: 'togoder_app' → '@togoder/mobile-app'
Delete stale package-lock.json files from packages/core/ and packages/mobile-app/ (monorepo uses pnpm)
close_reason: Packages renamed, lock files removed, .env copied, schemas/migrations verified identical

title: Phase 6: Cleanup old artifacts
description:
1. Remove /nginx/public/togoder_dev/ static files (no longer needed)
2. Mark old backend docker-compose at /backend/ToGODer/ as deprecated
3. Optionally consolidate git history from three repos into monorepo
close_reason: Deferring cleanup — old artifacts preserved as fallback for now

title: Phase 3: Create unified multi-stage Dockerfile
description:
Create single multi-stage Dockerfile at monorepo root:
Stage 1 (build-frontend): node:20 → pnpm install + expo export --platform web → static files
Stage 2 (build-backend): node:20 → pnpm install + tsc → compiled JS in bin/
Stage 3 (runtime): node:20-bookworm-slim → copy backend + frontend static files into ../Frontend (relative to bin/, matching express.static path) + prisma schema/migrations → startup: prisma migrate deploy && node bin/index.js

Also create docker-compose.yml: service togoder-dev, port 6968:6968, volume for data, env_file .env

IMPORTANT: Remove the old Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml from packages/core/ — they're copies from the standalone backend and will conflict with the new root-level ones.

IMPORTANT: Verify Express SPA catch-all. Currently only app.get('/') serves index.html. Need a wildcard fallback (e.g. app.get('*', sendFile index.html)) so deep links like /chat/123 work — nginx currently handles this via try_files but won't anymore.
close_reason: Multi-stage Dockerfile built, SPA catch-all added, old Docker files removed from core

title: Phase 4: Simplify nginx config
description:
Update /mnt/raid1/docker/nginx/conf.d/20-togoder-dev.conf:
- Remove root directive and 'location / { try_files }' — Express now serves static files
- Change location / to proxy_pass to 10.1.0.1:6968
- Keep WebSocket location with upgrade headers
- Keep /rss (port 19994) and /hex (port 19995) proxy blocks as-is
- Apply same changes to both HTTP (1999) and SSL (2000) server blocks
- Remove togoder_dev volume mount from nginx docker-compose.yml
close_reason: Nginx config simplified: all routes proxy to Express, removed togoder_dev volume mount

title: Phase 0: Backup database and tag repos
description:
1. Backup SQLite DB: cp /mnt/raid1/docker/togoder-dev/backend/data/dev.db /mnt/raid1/docker/togoder-dev/backend/data/dev.db.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d)
2. Tag current state in all three git repos (backend, frontend, togoder-monorepo)
3. Snapshot nginx static files: tar czf /mnt/raid1/docker/togoder-dev/togoder_dev_static_backup.tar.gz /mnt/raid1/docker/nginx/public/togoder_dev/
close_reason: DB backed up, all 3 repos tagged pre-monorepo-migration, nginx static files archived
